_meta.batch: Gripp CLUE X (~53 sceny, 277 terminow) - reakcje Grippa (showman) na kazdy dowod w grze. Kluczowa konfirmacja: HandwrittenLetter/ds0 wprost wspomina 'Ibis' (T.W. Ibis z batch_39, list z koordynatami lokalizacji lodzi Mortuga) - Gripp/Godrik NIE zna tej osoby, co jest zgodne z watkiem Wirmana. NewspaperPage/ds0 potwierdza pelna nazwe sklepu z poprawna pisownia 'Godrik Gripp' (w przeciwienstwie do 'Godman' z batch_56 Gripp SUS Gripp - prawdopodobnie literowka w tamtej partii zrodla).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json (soulTalking) - wiekszosc pokryta. Nieprzypisany (1): UnderwaterPhoto/ds12 (samo '...') - standardowe 'Grimoire (domniemany)'.
_meta.character_voice: Gripp: kontynuacja playful, teatralnego rejestru showmana (batch_08-09, batch_56).

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ActionFigure/Sec.en: Hm. That's the [i]Captain[/i], is it? And her accessories are a [i]compass[/i] and a [i]map?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ActionFigure/Sec.pl: Hm. To [i]Kapitan,[/i] tak? A jej akcesoria to [i]kompas[/i] i [i]mapa?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ActionFigure/Sec.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ActionFigure/Sec.en: So they made her the navigator [i]and[/i] the captain.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ActionFigure/Sec.pl: Więc zrobili z niej nawigatora [i]i[/i] kapitana.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ActionFigure/Sec.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: For most of its life, it was just - [i]ornamental[/i] - we put it out the front of the shop as a [i]billboard.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: Przez większość swojego istnienia był po prostu - [i]ozdobny[/i] - wystawialiśmy go przed sklepem jako [i]billboard.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: I don't know what to tell you-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: Okay so - you're not really an aeronaut, but you [i]did[/i] own a hot air balloon? For some reason?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: Okej, więc - tak naprawdę nie jesteś aeronautą, ale [i]jednak[/i] miałeś balon na ogrzane powietrze? Z jakiegoś powodu?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: No wonder you crashed, if you were trying to fly an [i]ornamental billboard.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: Nic dziwnego, że się rozbiłeś, skoro próbowałeś latać [i]ozdobnym billboardem.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: And then after you crashed it, you brought it [i]inside[/i] the submarine?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: A potem, po rozbiciu, wniosłeś go [i]do środka[/i] łodzi podwodnej?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: You'd rather I just let it sink into the ocean? Hm? Besides, it's useful;
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: Wolałabyś, żebym po prostu pozwolił mu zatonąć w oceanie? Hm? Poza tym jest przydatny;
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: And any time you wanted to check your [i]opening times[/i], they're right there.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: I za każdym razem, kiedy chciałabyś sprawdzić swoje [i]godziny otwarcia,[/i] są tam.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: Oh look, there you are - with the cane, as ever.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: O, spójrz, jesteś tam - z laską, jak zawsze.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: Of course, Mr Gripp always has [i]Cornelius Cane[/i] by his side!
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: Oczywiście, pan Gripp zawsze ma [i]Corneliusa Cane[/i] u swego boku!
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.en: Any time I want to re-read our [i]company mantra[/i], it's printed right there.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.pl: Za każdym razem, kiedy chcę odczytać ponownie naszą [i]mantrę firmową,[/i] jest tam wydrukowana.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BalloonBasket/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: Have you tried pushing the diamond thingy?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: That was the [i]first[/i] thing we tried.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: Not yet. We don't know how.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: Personally I think we just need a [i]crowbar.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.pl: Osobiście myślę, że potrzebujemy po prostu [i]łomu.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sect.en: Aha! [i]This[/i] must be where Madam Tadpole got her stage name...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sect.pl: Aha! [i]Tutaj[/i] Madam Tadpole musiała wziąć swój sceniczny pseudonim...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sect.en: You [i]think?[/i] She's not called Madam [i]Mermaid Orb.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sect.pl: [i]Naprawdę tak myślisz?[/i] Nie nazywa się Madam [i]Kula Syreny.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BlurryPhoto/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: You see, Miss Seafoam came to me with a compass she needed fixing.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: Widzicie, panna Seafoam przyszła do mnie z kompasem, który trzeba było naprawić.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: What's with all the needles and cogs and stuff?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: Co z tymi wszystkimi igłami i zębatkami i takimi tam?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: It looks like Gripp's halfway through [i]fixing[/i] it. That's what I figured, anyway.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: Wygląda na to, że Gripp jest w połowie [i]naprawiania[/i] go. Tak w każdym razie pomyślałem.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: Ah! Thank heavens, that's what I was hoping for.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: Ach! Dzięki niebiosom, właśnie na to liczyłem.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: I... went to put the needle back on, but Sinthia [i]stopped[/i] me.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: Ja... zamierzałem założyć igłę z powrotem, ale Sinthia mnie [i]powstrzymała.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: For some reason... she seemed to [i]need[/i] it to be true.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: Z jakiegoś powodu... wydawało się, że [i]potrzebuje,[/i] żeby to była prawda.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: She needed the compass to be broken...?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: I told her I had various spare needles I could try out as replacements, and uh - here we are.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: Powiedziałem jej, że mam różne zapasowe igły, które mógłbym wypróbować jako zamienniki, i, yy - i tak tu jesteśmy.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: And you left it out so Sinthia would [i]see[/i] it? So she'd think you [h]were[/h] actually fixing it?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: I zostawiłeś go na widoku, żeby Sinthia to [i]zobaczyła?[/i] Żeby myślała, że [h]naprawdę[/h] go naprawiasz?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: That's the idea, yes - so, if you'd kindly put it back where you found it?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: Taki był plan, tak - więc, czy moglibyście łaskawie odłożyć to tam, gdzie znaleźliście?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.en: [i]'The whole [h]thing[/h] is broken. You'll have to take a look at the insides. You'll have to replace the needle.'[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.pl: [i]'Cała [h]rzecz[/h] jest zepsuta. Będziesz musiał zajrzeć do środka. Będziesz musiał wymienić igłę.'[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE BrokenCompass/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsJacket/S.en: Ye-es! This was clearly made by someone who understands the value of [i]iconography![/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsJacket/S.pl: Ta-ak! To zostało wyraźnie zrobione przez kogoś, kto rozumie wartość [i]ikonografii![/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsJacket/S.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.en: Mortuga's log? Let's find the entry about me, shall we?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.pl: Dziennik Mortugi? Znajdźmy wpis o mnie, dobrze?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.en: Ah - here it is, right after Zephyr's;
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.pl: Ach - tutaj jest, zaraz po wpisie Zephyra;
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.en: [i]'Godrik Gripp rescued from hot air balloon accident.'[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.pl: [i]'Godrik Gripp uratowany z wypadku balonem na ogrzane powietrze.'[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.en: To refer to it as an [i]'accident'[/i] - a merciful gesture indeed...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.pl: Nazwanie tego [i]'wypadkiem'[/i] - to doprawdy litościwy gest...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaptainsLog/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.en: Hm? No... can't say I do...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.pl: Hm? Nie... nie mogę powiedzieć, żebym miał...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.en:
[i]'Rumored to be lost at sea... Requires a special key...'[/i]
Is that right...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.pl:
[i]'Podobno zaginiony na morzu... Wymaga specjalnego klucza...'[/i]
Czy to prawda...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.en: [i]The Mermaid's Tongue?[/i] Do you know anything about it?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.en: Based on this, I wonder if it may not even be [i]real[/i].
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.pl: Sądząc po tym, zastanawiam się, czy może nawet nie być [i]prawdziwy.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.en: After all, there isn't even a photograph - that's just a drawing.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.pl: W końcu nie ma nawet fotografii - to tylko rysunek.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaretakersJourna.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: [i]'No bladed weapon of any kind was found in the room.'[i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: [i]'W pomieszczeniu nie znaleziono żadnej broni białej.'[i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: ...any idea where it might be? Or [i]what...?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CellPhone/Sectio.en: I don't really deal in anything post-[i]Industrial Revolution.[/i] Try Sinthia.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CellPhone/Sectio.pl: Nie zajmuję się właściwie niczym po [i]rewolucji przemysłowej.[/i] Spróbujcie z Sinthią.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CellPhone/Sectio.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CellPhone/Sectio.en: [i]Teenage girl, cell phone...[/i] just - seems like a natural fit, wouldn't you say?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CellPhone/Sectio.pl: [i]Nastoletnia dziewczyna, telefon komórkowy...[/i] po prostu - wydaje się naturalnym połączeniem, nie sądzicie?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CellPhone/Sectio.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.en: But I stand by it - there's a chance Sinthia's got the wrong end of the stick.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.pl: Ale obstaję przy tym - jest szansa, że Sinthia coś źle zrozumiała.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.en: But if it's not about Sinthia and Mortuga, what [h]would[/h] it be about??
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.pl: Ale jeśli to nie o Sinthii i Mortudze, to o czym [h]by[/h] to było??
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.en: [i]'two individuals in contention over the ownership... however, a recent development has exposed...'[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.pl: [i]'dwie osoby sporujące o własność... jednakże niedawne wydarzenia ujawniły...'[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.en:
The [i]wording[/i], it's too vague.
It could be about anything.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.pl:
[i]Sformułowanie,[/i] jest zbyt niejasne.
Mogłoby dotyczyć czegokolwiek.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.en: He doesn't like it when I say [i]'wrong end of the stick'.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.pl: Nie lubi, kiedy mówię [i]'coś źle zrozumiała'.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.en: Perhaps she oughtn't be captain after all-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.pl: Może jednak nie powinna być kapitanem-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CommandContract/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: So what's the deal with this cauldron?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.pl: Więc o co chodzi z tym kotłem?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: Really? I figured you've been here a while, surely Mortuga would've - mentioned it?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.pl: Naprawdę? Myślałem, że jesteś tu już od jakiegoś czasu, na pewno Mortuga by - o tym wspomniał?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: He never did. Seems like he was keeping it secret.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.pl: Nigdy tego nie zrobił. Wygląda na to, że trzymał to w tajemnicy.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: Why would it [i]need[/i] to be a secret?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: It - wasn't really Mortuga's [i]modus operandi[/i] to be selfish like that.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.pl: To nie było naprawdę [i]modus operandi[/i] Mortugi, żeby być tak samolubnym.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: Maybe he just wanted it all for himself... whatever was [i]in[/i] there, I mean.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.pl: Może po prostu chciał to wszystko dla siebie... cokolwiek tam [i]było,[/i] mam na myśli.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: What, so keeping it secret was him being - [i]selfless?[/i] Somehow?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.pl: Co, więc trzymanie tego w tajemnicy było przejawem jego - [i]bezinteresowności?[/i] Jakoś?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: Like if it was [i]dangerous?[/i] He kept it hidden as a way of keeping you all safe?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.pl: Jak, gdyby to było [i]niebezpieczne?[/i] Ukrywał to, żeby was wszystkich chronić?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.en: Quite honestly, it's more likely to be the exact opposite.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.pl: Szczerze mówiąc, bardziej prawdopodobne jest coś dokładnie odwrotnego.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE CurseCauldron/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.en: Oh, I don't know, she probably did it to reduce [i]drag[/i], you know - like an [i]aerodynamics[/i] thing.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.pl: Och, nie wiem, pewnie zrobiła to, żeby zmniejszyć [i]opór,[/i] no wiesz - coś jak [i]aerodynamika.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.en: [i]He'll just have an entire conversation by himself, huh?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.pl: [i]On po prostu przeprowadzi całą rozmowę sam ze sobą, co?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.en: Eh - [i]hydro[/i]-dynamics, I guess. If that's a thing.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.pl: Eh - [i]hydro[/i]dynamika, chyba. Jeśli to w ogóle istnieje.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DivingLicense/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.en: In fact, I'm pretty sure he measured [i]Mortuga's head[/i] to get the shape right.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.pl: Właściwie, jestem całkiem pewien, że zmierzył [i]głowę Mortugi,[/i] żeby uzyskać właściwy kształt.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.en: D'you know if Zephyr made this himself?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.pl: Wiesz, czy Zephyr zrobił to sam?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.en: He [i]must've[/i] done - he didn't have it when I first got here.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.pl: [i]Musiał[/i] to zrobić - nie miał tego, kiedy tu po raz pierwszy przybyłem.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DreamHelmet/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.en:
Why does he-
Why does [i]it[/i] have a bandage around the middle?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.pl:
Czemu on-
Czemu [i]to[/i] ma bandaż wokół środka?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.en: Cornelius? Oh, he fell down the stairs - the [i]clumsy[/i] old thing.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.pl: Cornelius? Och, spadł ze schodów - ten [i]niezdarny[/i] staruszek.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.en: On a [i]submarine[/i]? It's all just [i]ladders[/i], isn't it?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.pl: Na [i]łodzi podwodnej?[/i] Tu wszystko to tylko [i]drabiny,[/i] prawda?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.en: I [i]promise[/i] you, that's [i]not[/i] the issue I have with that statement.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.pl: [i]Obiecuję[/i] ci, że [i]nie[/i] to jest problem, który mam z tym stwierdzeniem.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE DriftwoodCane/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sect.en: Oh yes, I remember hearing about this...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sect.pl: O tak, pamiętam, że słyszałem o tym...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sect.en: A submarine constructed by the harbormaster and the shipyard mechanic - who I [i]believe[/i] was her husband.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sect.pl: Łódź podwodna skonstruowana przez kapitanat portu i mechaniczkę stoczni - który, jak [i]wierzę,[/i] był jej mężem.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FamilyPhoto/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.en: He seemed [i]drawn[/i] to it - [i]entranced[/i] - always held within its... orbit, unable to... drift away.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.pl: Wydawał się [i]przyciągnięty[/i] do niego - [i]zauroczony[/i] - zawsze utrzymywany w jego... orbicie, niezdolny... odpłynąć.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.en: What d'you think, haunted? It's probably haunted, right?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.pl: Co myślicie, nawiedzony? Pewnie jest nawiedzony, prawda?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.en: If it [i]was[/i] haunted, then it was only because Mortuga [i]himself[/i] was its ghost-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.pl: Jeśli [i]był[/i] nawiedzony, to tylko dlatego, że sam Mortuga [i]był[/i] jego duchem-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FeliciaPainting/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.en: [i]Close your eyes, my love, and be still. For this is the end, and the beginning.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.pl: [i]Zamknij oczy, moja miłości, i znieruchom. Bo to jest koniec, i początek.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.speaker: Film

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.en: I heard that phrase spoken [i]aloud[/i] when I was in the bilge with Mariana Moon.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.pl: Słyszałem tę frazę wypowiedzianą [i]na głos,[/i] kiedy byłem w zęzie z Marianą Moon.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.en: -and this was around the time of the murder?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.pl: -i to było mniej więcej w czasie morderstwa?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FilmProjector/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FogBall/Section.pl: Hm? Co to takiego? Do czego to [i]służy?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FogBall/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE FogBall/Section.en: Whispering questions into the [i]'great unseen beyond'[/i], hoping without hope to get a response.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FogBall/Section.pl: Szeptanie pytań w [i]'wielkie niewidziane poza',[/i] mając nadzieję wbrew nadziei na odpowiedź.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE FogBall/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.en: Where on earth did you find [i]this??[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.en: It was just lying around. D'you know what it is?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.pl: Po prostu tam leżało. Wiesz, co to jest?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.en: What I [i]do[/i] know, is that it belonged to [i]Mortuga.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.en: But you don't know what it was actually [i]for?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.pl: Ale nie wiesz, do czego to właściwie [i]służyło?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.en: I couldn’t say with any academic certainty.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.pl: Nie potrafię powiedzieć z żadną akademicką pewnością.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GlassEyeball/Sec.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE GoldenLocket/Sec.en: By all accounts, some kind of [i]sorceress.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GoldenLocket/Sec.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE GoldenLocket/Sec.en: Well, it's a [i]brass trinket[/i], and thus it's often placed within the jurisdiction of my expertise.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GoldenLocket/Sec.pl: Cóż, to [i]mosiężny drobiazg,[/i] a więc często wpada w zakres mojej ekspertyzy.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE GoldenLocket/Sec.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.en: Could this be Sinthia's attempt to get our submarine up to code and finally install a radio?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.pl: Czy to może być próba Sinthii, żeby doprowadzić naszą łódź podwodną do normy i wreszcie zainstalować radio?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.en: Why [i]doesn't[/i] the ship have a radio?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.en: One; Mortuga didn't like to use [i]technology[/i] if he could avoid it-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.pl: Po pierwsze; Mortuga nie lubił używać [i]technologii,[/i] jeśli mógł tego uniknąć-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.en: -and two; he didn't like to [i]communicate with the outside world[/i] if he could avoid it.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.pl: -a po drugie; nie lubił [i]komunikować się ze światem zewnętrznym,[/i] jeśli mógł tego uniknąć.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.en: I'm not sure I agree with that second one.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.pl: Nie jestem pewna, czy zgadzam się z tym drugim.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.en: There's no way [i]all these people[/i] showed up on the submarine if Mortuga wasn't contacting the outside world.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.pl: Nie ma mowy, żeby [i]wszyscy ci ludzie[/i] pojawili się na łodzi podwodnej, gdyby Mortuga nie kontaktował się ze światem zewnętrznym.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.en: You know, there may be something [i]to[/i] that.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandheldRadio/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.en: Hm. This 'Ibis' person claiming to have [i]information on Mortuga...[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.pl: Hm. Ta osoba 'Ibis' twierdząca, że ma [i]informacje o Mortudze...[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.en: No! Mortuga [i]never[/i] mentioned anyone by that name... not to [i]me[/i], anyway.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.pl: Nie! Mortuga [i]nigdy[/i] nie wspomniał o nikim o tym imieniu... przynajmniej nie [i]mnie.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.en: [i]'Inked on the back of this letter are co-ordinates detailing how, when and where to find The Mortuga Submarine...'[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.pl: [i]'Na odwrocie tego listu wypisane są atramentem współrzędne szczegółowo opisujące jak, kiedy i gdzie znaleźć Łódź Podwodną Mortuga...'[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HandwrittenLette.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexBottle/Sectio.en: There's some kind of [i]pattern...[/i] it almost looks [i]pictoral.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexBottle/Sectio.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexBottle/Sectio.en: Mm, it might do - I imagine poor old [i]Zephyr's[/i] been trying his best to figure it out.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexBottle/Sectio.pl: Mm, może i tak - wyobrażam sobie, że biedny stary [i]Zephyr[/i] robił, co mógł, żeby to rozgryźć.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexBottle/Sectio.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexoftheHelmsman.en: -then again, I suppose it is [i]largely[/i] imaginary and [i]mostly[/i] guesswork. I'd imagine that gets him off the hook.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexoftheHelmsman.pl: -z drugiej strony, przypuszczam, że to [i]w dużej mierze[/i] wymysł i [i]przeważnie[/i] domysły. Wyobrażam sobie, że to go rozgrzesza.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexoftheHelmsman.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexoftheHelmsman.en: [i]Nope.[/i] Doesn't say it [i]anywhere.[/i] No [i]'based on'[/i], no [i]'inspired by'[/i]...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexoftheHelmsman.pl: [i]Nie.[/i] Nie ma tego [i]nigdzie.[/i] Ani [i]'na podstawie',[/i] ani [i]'zainspirowane przez'...[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE HexoftheHelmsman.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE IllusionistPoste.en: Ah - that's Symmetry, I assume...? And she's sitting on the cauldron... facing a window?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IllusionistPoste.pl: Ach - to Symmetry, jak sądzę...? I siedzi na kotle... zwrócona do okna?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IllusionistPoste.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE IllusionistPoste.en: Cornelius tells me he spotted [i]Miss Silkmoth[/i] drawing this while she was in the mess hall...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IllusionistPoste.pl: Cornelius mówi mi, że dostrzegł, jak [i]panna Silkmoth[/i] to rysuje, kiedy była w mesie...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IllusionistPoste.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE IllusionistPoste.en: Mm, let's have a look, shall we?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IllusionistPoste.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: Ah, yes - I believe it belongs to [i]Sinthia?[/i] And she gave it to [i]Mortuga...[/i] shortly after she first arrived?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Ach, tak - wierzę, że należy do [i]Sinthii?[/i] I dała go [i]Mortudze...[/i] niedługo po tym, jak po raz pierwszy przybyła?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: Gripp, what d'you know about this document?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Gripp, co wiesz o tym dokumencie?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.en: I'm guessing you never dealt with anything like [i]this[/i] in your shop.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Zgaduję, że nigdy nie miałeś do czynienia z niczym takim jak [i]to[/i] w swoim sklepie.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.en: No, no - it's too [i]big[/i], for one - and it's not exactly navigation... related...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Nie, nie - jest zbyt [i]duże,[/i] po pierwsze - i nie jest to dokładnie związane z... nawigacją...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.en: I don't suppose you know what [i]this[/i] is? This little part sticking out the back?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Nie sądzę, żebyś wiedział, czym [i]to[/i] jest? Ta mała część wystająca z tyłu?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.en: No. I barely noticed it, to be honest.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Nie. Szczerze mówiąc, ledwo to zauważyłem.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sec.en: Ah, Miss Silkmoth's a [i]talented[/i] seamstress - and she carved and painted the head, too?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sec.pl: Ach, panna Silkmoth to [i]utalentowana[/i] krawcowa - i wyrzeźbiła i pomalowała też głowę?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sec.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.en: I wouldn't lose sleep over it if I were you.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.pl: Na waszym miejscu nie traciłbym z tego powodu snu.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.en: Ah, yes. Can't really [i]miss[/i] it, can you?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.pl: Ach, tak. Trudno tego [i]nie zauważyć,[/i] prawda?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.en: It's creeping me out, but I [h]really[/h] want to know what it is.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.pl: To mnie przeraża, ale [h]naprawdę[/h] chcę wiedzieć, co to jest.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MermaidPainting/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.en: Well, that's a [i]delightful little habit[/i], isn't it?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.en: I'm pretty sure Tadpole fished it out of the ocean.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.pl: Jestem całkiem pewna, że Tadpole wyłowiła ją z oceanu.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.en: There's a little drawing, too - some kind of symbol?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.pl: Jest też mały rysunek - jakiś symbol?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.en: To me it looks like a [i]diagram.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.en: That's how she got [i]all[/i] the stuff in her room, I think.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.pl: Tak zdobyła [i]wszystkie[/i] te rzeczy w swoim pokoju, jak sądzę.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MessageinaBottle.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.en: A quaint little pretense of Silkwirm-on-sea, as beheld in the mind's eye of one [i]Magnus Mortuga.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.pl: Osobliwy, mały pozór Silkwirm nad Morzem, taki, jaki dostrzegło oko umysłu pewnego [i]Magnusa Mortugi.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.en: Did you [i]know[/i] Mortuga had made this?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.en: I'd seen it once or twice, when he was first working on it...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.pl: Widziałem to raz czy dwa, kiedy dopiero nad tym pracował...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.en: ...but I always got the impression it was something he wished to keep to [i]himself[/i].
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.pl: ...ale zawsze miałem wrażenie, że to coś, co chciał zachować dla [i]siebie.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ModelTown/Sectio.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: We think Mortuga might've dropped this when he was killed.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Myślimy, że Mortuga mógł to upuścić, kiedy został zabity.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: [h]You[/h] can think that all you like - personally, I think it came from somewhere else.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: [h]Ty[/h] możesz sobie tak myśleć, ile chcesz - osobiście myślę, że pochodzi skądinąd.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: If it wasn't dropped by [i]Mortuga[/i]... perhaps it was dropped by the [i]culprit?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Jeśli nie upuścił go [i]Mortuga...[/i] może upuścił go [i]sprawca?[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Mógł to być żaden z nich.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: You're suggesting this bottle made its [h]own[/h] way into the crime scene?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Sugerujesz, że ta butelka dostała się na miejsce zbrodni [h]sama?[/h]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MovieMagazine/Se.en: It's just the poster, I'm sure there are more in the actual film.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MovieMagazine/Se.pl: To tylko plakat, jestem pewien, że w samym filmie jest ich więcej.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MovieMagazine/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE MovieMagazine/Se.en: If it sticks to the novel, there actually [i]might[/i] only be two characters.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MovieMagazine/Se.pl: Jeśli trzyma się powieści, [i]rzeczywiście[/i] mogą być tylko dwie postaci.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE MovieMagazine/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.en: [i]'Godrik Gripp's Nautical and Aeronautical Precision Measurement and Navigation Instruments.'[/i] Great name-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.pl: [i]'Instrumenty Precyzyjnego Pomiaru i Nawigacji Morskiej oraz Lotniczej Godrika Grippa.'[/i] Świetna nazwa-
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.en: Yes, well, this was shortly before the [i]rebrand.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.pl: Tak, cóż, to było niedługo przed [i]rebrandingiem.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.en: Why'd you decide to rebrand the shop?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.en: Ah, you see - the news about the Silkwirm Serpent put the town in a particular sort of [i]mood-[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.pl: Ach, widzicie - wieści o Wężu z Silkwirm wprawiły miasteczko w szczególny rodzaj [i]nastroju-[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.en: -interest in all things [i]'nautical adventure'[/i] was on the rise, you know, they put up that [i]statue[/i], we'd get [i]tourists[/i], even...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.pl: -zainteresowanie wszystkim, co [i]'morska przygoda',[/i] rosło, no wiecie, postawili ten [i]posąg,[/i] mieliśmy nawet [i]turystów...[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.en: So you capitalized on the zeitgeist?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE NewspaperPage/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE RaggedCloth/Sect.en: This is from a ship's sail...?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE RaggedCloth/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE RaggedCloth/Sect.en: Did [i]you[/i] sell sails? in your shop?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE RaggedCloth/Sect.pl: Czy [i]ty[/i] sprzedawałeś żagle? W swoim sklepie?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE RaggedCloth/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE RaggedCloth/Sect.en: No, ship parts like that fell within the remit of the [i]Drummond Shipyard[/i], a few doors down.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE RaggedCloth/Sect.pl: Nie, takie części statków wchodziły w zakres [i]Stoczni Drummonda,[/i] kilka drzwi dalej.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE RaggedCloth/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SeaChart/Section.pl: No cóż, to jest właśnie [i]pytanie,[/i] prawda?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: It's from my [i]personal collection[/i]... I really hadn't intended for you to see it.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SeaChart/Section.pl: To z mojej [i]osobistej kolekcji...[/i] naprawdę nie zamierzałem, żebyście to zobaczyli.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: What's it a map [i]to[/i], anyway? What's at the red X?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SeaChart/Section.pl: A [i]do czego[/i] w ogóle to mapa? Co jest przy czerwonym X?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.en: Oh yes... Mortuga's little model ship.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.en: He always kept it on his [i]desk.[/i] Although I'd wager it's more than just a [i]paperweight...[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.pl: Zawsze trzymał go na swoim [i]biurku.[/i] Chociaż zaryzykowałbym, że to coś więcej niż tylko [i]przycisk do papieru...[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.en: It's likely, Mortuga did [i]have[/i] a ship - or, rather, he worked on [i]board[/i] one, I very much doubt he was the... owner...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.pl: Prawdopodobnie, Mortuga [i]rzeczywiście[/i] miał statek - a raczej, pracował na jego [i]pokładzie,[/i] mocno wątpię, żeby był... właścicielem...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.en: Maybe something left over from when it was painted?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.pl: Może coś, co zostało po pomalowaniu?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipinaBottle/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.en: D'you know how the wheel got damaged?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.en: It looks in working order to me...?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.en: No, look... some of the spokes are different.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.pl: Nie, spójrz... niektóre szprychy są inne.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.en: It looks like they broke off and got replaced.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.pl: Wygląda na to, że się odłamały i zostały wymienione.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.en: Although it's not exactly at odds with the ship as a [i]whole,[/i] is it?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.pl: Chociaż to nie do końca kłóci się ze statkiem jako [i]całością,[/i] prawda?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.en: Look around you! She's a [i]ramshackle[/i] old thing.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.en: Sturdy, yes, even [i]handsome[/i] in places... but undeniably a [i]patchwork[/i] of sorts.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.pl: Solidna, tak, nawet [i]okazała[/i] miejscami... ale niezaprzeczalnie swego rodzaju [i]łatanina.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE ShipsWheel/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.en: Cornelius, look - I [i]told[/i] you all our hard work would 'put us on the map' some day.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.pl: Corneliusie, spójrz - [i]mówiłem[/i] ci, że cała nasza ciężka praca kiedyś nas 'wprowadzi na mapę'.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.en: How come your logo is a [i]hot air balloon?[/i] I thought you sold stuff for boats.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.pl: Czemu twoje logo to [i]balon na ogrzane powietrze?[/i] Myślałam, że sprzedajesz rzeczy do łodzi.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.en: [i]Ah-hem...[/i] officially we deal in the nautical [i]and[/i] aeronautical.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.pl: [i]Ach-hem...[/i] oficjalnie zajmujemy się sprawami morskimi [i]i[/i] lotniczymi.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.en: But in truth, the balloon motif was mostly just for fun - I'm not sure there [i]were[/i] ever any aeronauts in Silkwirm...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.pl: Ale prawdę mówiąc, motyw balonu był głównie dla zabawy - nie jestem pewien, czy w Silkwirm [i]w ogóle[/i] byli kiedyś jacyś aeronauci...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SilkwirmMap/Sect.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE StrangeDevice/Se.en: I only deal with the mechanical, the clockwork, and, at a [i]push[/i] - the hydraulic.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE StrangeDevice/Se.pl: Zajmuję się jedynie mechaniką, mechanizmami zegarowymi i, w [i]ostateczności[/i] - hydrauliką.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE StrangeDevice/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE StrangeDevice/Se.en: Doesn't appear to do [i]anything[/i], does it? Perhaps it's broken.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE StrangeDevice/Se.pl: Nie wygląda na to, żeby [i]cokolwiek[/i] robiło, prawda? Może jest zepsute.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE StrangeDevice/Se.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.en: They say... Mortuga bought an [i]incomplete[/i] submarine, and then paid for it to be completed.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.pl: Mówią... że Mortuga kupił [i]niedokończoną[/i] łódź podwodną, a potem zapłacił, żeby ją dokończono.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.en: What's the deal with this [i]blueprint?[/i] It's kind of a [i]mess.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.pl: O co chodzi z tym [i]planem?[/i] To trochę [i]bałagan.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.en: So it only makes sense that the blueprint's as [i]ramshackle[/i] as the ship itself.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.pl: Więc ma sens, że plan jest tak [i]rozklekotany[/i] jak sam statek.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.en: [i]One[/i], the [i]shipyard[/i], I imagine, and [i]two[/i] - I have no idea! He never seemed to have any money...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.pl: [i]Po pierwsze,[/i] [i]stocznia,[/i] wyobrażam sobie, a [i]po drugie[/i] - nie mam pojęcia! Nigdy nie wydawał się mieć pieniędzy...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SubmarineBluepri.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE SunTablets/Secti.en: Probably. Although it could be a [i]wheel.[/i]
Conversation/Gripp CLUE SunTablets/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Gripp CLUE Typewriter/Secti.en: Wirman still attempting to [i]wrestle[/i] his grand opus into existence, is he?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE Typewriter/Secti.pl: Wirman wciąż próbuje [i]wywalczyć[/i] swoje wielkie dzieło do istnienia, tak?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE Typewriter/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE Typewriter/Secti.en: I rather thought he'd be [i]done[/i] by now...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE Typewriter/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.en: Well it's a [i]face[/i], I suppose we can agree on that.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.pl: Cóż, to [i]twarz,[/i] przypuszczam, że co do tego się zgadzamy.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.en: Doesn't look like any face [i]I've[/i] ever seen.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.pl: Nie wygląda jak żadna twarz, którą [i]ja[/i] kiedykolwiek widziałam.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.en:
No, well...
Perhaps you ought to count yourself lucky.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.pl:
Nie, cóż...
Może powinnaś uznać się za szczęściarę.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.en: ...Cornelius thinks it might be his great [i]grandmother.[/i] For all I know, he may be right.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.pl: ...Cornelius myśli, że to może być jego [i]prababcia.[/i] Z tego, co wiem, może mieć rację.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.en: It - belonged to Mortuga? I assume?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.en: Yes - and to me it sits right alongside that [i]iron bell[/i] in his office and that [i]stone cauldron[/i] in the store room...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.pl: Tak - i dla mnie stoi to tuż obok tego [i]żelaznego dzwonu[/i] w jego biurze i tego [i]kamiennego kotła[/i] w magazynie...
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.en: Together they form Mortuga's collection of [i]inexplicably cursed-looking[/i] nautical artifacts.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.pl: Razem tworzą kolekcję Mortugi [i]niewytłumaczalnie przeklęcie wyglądających[/i] morskich artefaktów.
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenBuoy/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenPipe/Secti.en: That's it! Mariana's pipe! She let you see it?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenPipe/Secti.pl: To to! Fajka Mariany! Pozwoliła wam to zobaczyć?
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenPipe/Secti.speaker: Gripp

Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenPipe/Secti.en: Well alright then! End of conversation, apparently!
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenPipe/Secti.pl: No dobrze więc! Podobno koniec rozmowy!
Conversation/Gripp CLUE WoodenPipe/Secti.speaker: Gripp
